entry.title: Session 12: the Teague contract
entry.body: At Regina highport. [[cr_00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003|Captain Rhys]] found the broker Harlan Teague at Teague Freight in Startown and took eleven tons of machine parts for Efate, Cr22,000 on delivery. Teague mentioned a woman, Mira Sato, asking after the ship; she left a card for the Imperial Navy liaison office. [[cr_00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004|Voss]] stayed aboard. The ship lifted on day 101 and arrived in Efate orbit on day 108.

evidence.quote: Okay, last time you were docked at Regina highport with the mail contract.
